headline: Indian Nifty 50 touches 9-month high as foreign inflows exceed ₹1 lakh crore
summary: Foreign portfolio investors injected over ₹1 lakh crore into Indian equities in November, driving the Nifty 50 index to a nine-month high. The Indian rupee registered its strongest weekly gain in five weeks while government bond yields declined.
why: The Nifty 50 serves as India's benchmark equity index, reflecting overall corporate performance and cross-border portfolio investment flows.
